---
name: Bug report
about: Create a report to help us improve MapFlip
title: '[BUG] '
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

**Source URL or Link**
The map URL that caused the issue (e.g. `https://maps.apple.com/...`).

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Target Map App**
Which navigation app is configured in MapFlip (e.g. Google Maps, OsmAnd, Organic Maps, Waze, etc.)?

**Device Details:**
- Device: [e.g. Google Pixel 8, Samsung Galaxy S24]
- Android Version: [e.g. Android 14, Android 15]
- MapFlip Flavor: [Google Play / F-Droid / GitHub APK]
- MapFlip Version: [e.g. 1.2.16]

**Additional context**
Add any other context about the problem here.
